description.name: Basic Attack: Robin Attack
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>;

description.name: Dodge: Robin Dodge
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Dash> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dash Attack: Robin Dash
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform an attack forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Robin Counter
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Swing the staff to attack enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Robin Exit
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Leaps high into the air and unleashes an Energy Blast around her, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After activation, triggers a Quick Assist. After switching out, Robin enters the [Off-Field Guard] state for 60s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. Also grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to 2% of Robin's initial Max HP, lasting 15s.
While Robin is in the [Off-Field Guard] state, she can only be switched in via [Chain Attack], [Entry Skill], or [Counter Assist]. Switching her in ends the [Off-Field Guard] state.
While [Off-Field Guard] is active, all squad members gain bonus DEF: when Robin's initial Max HP exceeds 16,000, every 1,000 additional HP grants <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:44+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*3,1,3}</color> DEF, up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:440+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*30,1,2}</color> DEF. This effect lasts for another 15s after Robin's [Off-Field Guard] state ends.

description.name: Special Attack: Aftershock
EX Special Attack: Enhanced Aftershock
Chain Attack: Robin Chain Attack
description.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Fires a powerful laser forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Robin Ultimate
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Channels powerful energy through song to unleash a devastating blast, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Upon activation, converts 40% of each squad Agent's [Robin Shield] into their own HP.

description.name: Entry Skill: Robin Entrance
description.desc:
When at 100 or more [Entry Points], switching this character on field or holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> consumes 100 [Entry Points] to activate:
Unleashes an Energy blast at enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Activating this skill counts as activating a [Quick Assist].
Provides all squad members with a [Robin Shield] equal to 4% of this character's initial Max HP, lasting 20s.

description.name: Quick Assist: Robin Assist
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Swing the staff to attack enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Robin Defensive Assist
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Robin Assist Follow-Up
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Swing the staff to attack enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Counter Assist: Robin Counter
description.desc:
When you or the on-field character is about to be hit by certain enemies' Control Skills, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Engage in a power clash with the monster. If successful, neutralize the enemy's Control Skill and deal <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Grapple Assault
Assist Follow-Up: Grappling Synergy Strike
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after other squad members activate a <color=#FFFFFF>Counter Assist</color> to activate:
Fire a powerful laser forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive:
Additional Ability:
desc:
Triggers when another character in your squad is an [Armorer] or [Stun] Character:
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 [Buff Enhance Point]. In Domain Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.

name: Core Passive:
Additional Ability:
desc:
When Robin uses certain skills, she grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] that scales with Robin's initial Max HP, lasting 15s. Gaining [Robin Shield] again stacks the shield amount and extends its duration, up to a maximum of 60s. The shield amount cannot exceed 8% of Robin's initial Max HP.
Each time all squad members gain [Robin Shield], their DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>14.6%</color> for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
Using [Special Attack: Step Up] triggers a Quick Assist. After switching out, Robin enters the [Off-Field Guard] state for 60s. While in [Off-Field Guard], Robin gains [Entry Points] when she uses Aftershocks, up to a maximum of 120 points.
When [Entry Points] are at 100 or above, Robin can be actively switched in via [Entry Skill]. On switching in, she automatically consumes 100 [Entry Points] to use [Entry Skill] and exits the [Off-Field Guard] state.
When using [Entry Skill], Robin gains 1 [Buff Enhance Point], up to a maximum of 1.
When entering the [Off-Field Guard] state, if Robin has a [Buff Enhance Point], she consumes 1 [Buff Enhance Point] to further increase the DEF boost granted by [Off-Field Guard] and its cap by 25%.
Each time a squad member triggers Maim, Robin restores 15 Energy.
